headline: Bahodir Jurayev becomes chairman of "Uzbekistan National Electric Networks"
summary: Bahodir Jurayev has been appointed chairman of Uzbekistan National Electric Grids JSC. He had led the Thermal Power Plants management since 2023.
why: Uzbekistan National Electric Grids operates the country's high-voltage transmission network, so its leadership shapes power infrastructure investment and reliability.
original_headline: Bahodir Jurayev “O‘zbekiston milliy elektr tarmoqlari” raisi bo‘ldi
